text:
maria: ALERT: notifyd heartbeat missing on 3 nodes (eu-west-1) for 5m. Possible suppressed pages. @ops-oncall can you confirm? https://grafana.company/alert/123
incident-bot: [auto] suppression rule triggered for notifyd:heartbeat-stale (rule id: sup-42). Pages queued -> suppressed. See /integrations/logs
jake: I see a spike of 502/504 from notify-relay in the same window. relay logs show `suppressed=true` on attempts to PD.
alice: Customer impact: three customers (acme, bloomtech, shoply) report delayed deliveries — support ticket spike ~18 msgs/hr
kevin: Is this the suppressor TTL mismatch we saw last month? could be config reload order again
maria: quick logs:
```
[2026-03-18T15:10:02Z] WARN notifyd: heartbeat-stale node=node-7
[2026-03-18T15:10:03Z] INFO suppressor: matched rule=sup-42 action=suppress
[2026-03-18T15:10:04Z] ERROR relay: pd_post failed status=502 body=\"Bad Gateway\"
```
ops-oncall: Taking primary. Flipping fallback: enabling sms-fallback route and disabling suppressor for notifyd now. Will send manual PD pages to affected oncall groups.
maria: Commands I'm running: `./deploy/tools/notifyctl --service notifyd suppressor disable --for 1h` (testing in canary)
ton y: I opened a hotfix PR to make suppressor load-order deterministic: https://github.com/redwood/notifyd/pull/812
jake: Manual pages sent to PD for EU oncall at 15:18Z. Confirmed ack from lead oncall (rufus)
alice: Support: triage doc updated, notified customers with incident ack. Ticket backlog reduced after manual page
ops-oncall: Mitigation steps complete. Pages flowing again. Will keep suppressor disabled until patch merges and we run a config reload. ETA 45m
incident-bot: [auto] suppression rule sup-42 set to disabled by ops-oncall@ops-oncall
maria: Postmortem notes to add: suppressor should never evaluate before heartbeat aggregator. Add integration test for startup order.
kevin: Also add metric for suppressed_page_count per-rule (we had zero visibility)
ops-oncall: Recording timeline and customer impact in incident tracker: https://tracker.company/incident/INC-2026-045
jake: Recovered. No further customer escalations for past 20m. :white_check_mark:
alice: Recommend follow-up: ship patch, rotate canary, run chaos test on service restarts
ops-oncall: Thanks all — handing back to on-call SRE to follow postmortem. Closing live mitigation at 15:55Z
